item.description: SCWP Networking Mixer ✨ Presence Under Pressure: Cultivating Confidence from the Inside Out ✨ What if confidence isn’t something you have to perform—but something you can learn to embody? Join Sonoma County Women Professionals on Tuesday, September 1 for an inspiring and practical presentation with Michelle Maree, speaking and visibility coach, trauma-trained therapist, and somatic guide. Michelle will share practical, evidence-based tools to help you: • Communicate with greater confidence and clarity • Stay grounded in high-pressure situations • Regulate your nervous system when the stakes are high • Navigate challenging conversations with authenticity • Turn pressure into an opportunity for greater connection and influence Whether you’re presenting to an audience, networking, leading a team, or simply looking to show up more confidently, you’ll leave with tools you can use in both business and life. item.description: The September 3 Wake Up with the Metro Chamber event will focus on homelessness as one of the region's most significant economic, public safety, humanitarian, and quality-of-life challenges. item.title: Visiting Artist Lecture Series — Thu Sep 3, 12:00 PM — Sonoma State University
item.description:
The Visiting Artist Lecture series is hosted by the Sonoma State University Art Studio program and is held in room Art 102 unless otherwise noted.
**Setpember 10 -** Chanell Stone (b. Los Angeles) is an artist living and working in Oakland, California. Her practice examines the phenomenology of the female body as both a geographic site and physical material embedded within the American landscape. Grounded in the interdisciplinary frameworks of Black feminist thought and image-based media, Stone theorizes how memory and place are inscribed onto and throughout the body. Her inquiries take form through photography, poetry and material-based exploration, wherein she engages with lesser-known impressions of Black American presence and belonging.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.title: Sourdough Bread Basics — Sat Sep 5, 10:30 AM — Gather Sebastopol
item.description:
Dive into the world of sourdough baking in this hands-on class! Learn how to create and feed a sourdough starter, master the basics of bulk fermentation, and shape different types of loaves. Along the way, you’ll gain an understanding of timing, technique, and the simple ingredients that make sourdough bread so special.
Perfect for beginners ready to explore artisan breadmaking, this workshop gives you both the knowledge and practice to confidently bake at home.
You’ll take home:
• A lively sourdough starter to keep your baking journey going.
• One pre-bulk fermented loaf, shaped in class, ready to bake the same day.
• One freshly mixed boule to ferment overnight and bake the next day.
Source: Press Democrat

item.title: Arjun Verma - Northern Classical Indian Concert — Sat Sep 5, 2:00 PM — Windsor Regional Library
item.description:
Immerse yourself in Northern Indian Classical music featuring sitar and tabla. Arjun K. Verma is an Indian-American sitarist and composer. Beginning with his father, Roop Verma, and continuing with the legendary Ali Akbar Khan and his son Alam Khan, Arjun's meticulous training has imbued him with a rich musicality that encompasses both the profound majesty and the exhilaration of North Indian classical music. Hailed by the New York Times as a "fine sitarist," Arjun shares the jewels of his cultural heritage in a manner that is fresh, modern, and relevant, while maintaining a high standard of traditional integrity.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.title: Culinary Garden Cooking Classes at Quivira Vineyards — Sun Sep 6, 12:00 AM — Quivira Vineyards and Winery
item.description:
Join an immersive, hands-on culinary series at Quivira Vineyards, offered June 7-November 15 from 11 AM - 2 PM. Led by Estate Chef Julia, guests begin in the organic estate garden harvesting seasonal ingredients before moving to the open-air kitchen to prepare a garden-inspired, multi-course meal. This interactive experience highlights the connection between garden, vineyard, and kitchen, while teaching practical culinary techniques. The evening concludes with a shared meal paired with Quivira wines in a beautiful estate setting. Each date features a different focus, including handmade pasta, masa and tacos, stuffed pasta, global dumplings, and seasonal pie baking. Space is limited for these unique seasonal classes.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.title: Winemaker Harvest Walk & Tasting at West Wines — Sun Sep 6, 9:45 AM — West Wines
item.description:
Join West Wines winemaker Katarina for a unique harvest experience Winemaker Harvest Walk & Tasting on September 6, 12, or 19. Meet at the West Wines Tasting Room before heading into the upper vineyard, where sweeping views of Dry Creek Valley set the scene for an intimate, small-group experience. Guests will pick grape samples and learn how winemakers determine the ideal time to harvest while field-testing sugar and pH and tasting grapes straight from the vine. Katarina will share insights into harvest decisions and other aspects of winemaking before leading a wine tasting on the vine-side patio. Groups are limited to 10 guests. Comfortable, closed-toe shoes with good soles are recommended for the uneven hillside terrain. Boxed lunches and charcuterie are available for pre-order.
Source: North Bay Bohemian
